# Page 1


```{r}
df <- read.csv("data/baseball _records.csv")


```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

df %>% 
  filter(player_name == 'Yoda', hit_type == "HR") %>% 
  select(player_name, hit_type) %>% 
  group_by(player_name) %>% 
  summarise(n = n())




  
  
  


  

```

# Total Batting Average

![]()

```{r}
## Total At Bat
total_at_bat <- df %>% 
  filter(event != 'BB') %>% 
  count(player_name) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))

## Total HIT
total_hit <- df %>% 
  filter(event == 'HIT') %>% 
  count(player_name) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))


batting_ave <- df %>% 
    mutate(
        total = event != "BB",
        hit = event == "HIT"
    ) %>% 
    group_by(player_name) %>% 
    summarise(
      AB = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      H = sum(hit, na.rm = TRUE),
      AV = H/AB)  %>% 
  arrange(desc(AB))



batting_ave
```

## Batting Average of Softball

```{r}
batting_ave_s <- df %>% 
    filter(sport == 's') %>% 
    mutate(
        total = event != "BB",
        hit = event == "HIT"
    ) %>% 
    group_by(player_name) %>% 
    summarise(
      AB = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      H = sum(hit, na.rm = TRUE),
      AV = H/AB)  %>% 
  arrange(desc(H))

batting_ave_s

```
